elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your Android can go darker than the lowest brightness.

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Extra dim.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Accessibility. Tap Extra dim and switch it on. On a Samsung, it's under Vision enhancements.

[delighted] Now you can read in bed without squinting at the screen.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
